count_policy: 75 content groups: 50 objectives + 5 regular Section A groups + 20 Section B groups. 91 leaves: 50 objectives + 8 regular A leaves + 33 B leaves. Printed nested 17(a)(i)/(ii) are separate leaves. Unlabelled multiple outputs/code blanks stay together.

verification_scope: All GFG descriptive pages 5–8 visually inspected. GateForum descriptive pages examined with OCR and targeted visual checks of pp9,11,13–15. Objective page boundaries checked using OCR and rasters; not a full option-by-option equivalence audit. Page references are physical PDF pages; ranges may include shared stem pages. No solutions copied or authored.

discrepancies.note: GateForum p2 has visibly malformed grammar symbols/nonterminal labels. GFG p1 has a different-looking reproduction. Authors must inspect both rasters, preserve uncertainty, and not infer grammar solely from OCR.
GateForum p2 omits codeword 101010, which GFG p2 includes between 010101 and 000111.
GateForum p3 asks what information needs to be included; GFG p2 asks what need NOT be included. The missing negation materially changes the MCQ.
GateForum p3 option (c) says R is reflexive and hence not an equivalence relation; GFG p2 says R is NOT reflexive. This is a material option transcription discrepancy.
GateForum p9 prints malformed Y := abs(bA-b); GFG p6 prints Y := abs(A-B). Both give A=5CH and B=92H; OCR may misread H as 14.

discrepancies.question: 7(b)
discrepancies.note: GateForum p11 visibly prints denominator 0 in sin(x)/0, while GFG p6 prints x. Treat as reproduction discrepancy, not a literal common limit.
GateForum p11 renders grammar minus symbols as low underscores in Expr -> _Expr and ExprTail -> _Expr. GFG p6 shows minus signs. Preserve the grammar and token convention explicitly.

discrepancies.question: 14(b)
discrepancies.note: GateForum p13 prints 360 rpm; GFG p7 prints 3600 rpm. This changes the requested transfer rate by a factor of ten; do not silently merge variants.

discrepancies.question: 15(a)
discrepancies.note: Both rasters retain complement bars on A and B in Z = complement(A) + complement(B) + C. Plain extracted text loses these bars.

discrepancies.question: 16(c)
discrepancies.note: Neither reproduction supplies memory contents for the search program. Final HL cannot be assigned one fixed value without stating a match/no-match condition. This is a source sufficiency caveat, not an extra leaf.
GateForum p14 declares RAM but uses REM; GFG p8 declares REM. All three code blanks A/B/C are unlabelled suboutputs of one printed group, retained as one leaf.
GateForum pp14–15 prints V(c) after S4 and repeats P(j); P(j); P(k) before S9. GFG p8 prints V(e) after S4 and only P(j); P(k) before S9. These are material synchronization variants.
GateForum p15 omits the drawn A–B edge while leaving its weight 2 in the diagram. GFG p8 clearly draws A–B with weight 2. Do not treat the detached number as an additional graph item.

discrepancies.question: 26(a)
discrepancies.note: GFG p8 explicitly prints (3) after part (a); GateForum p16 omits this allocation. Part (b) has no printed mark. Preserve the observed 3 and leave (b) null.

discrepancies.question: marks
discrepancies.note: GFG section A heading is 100 marks; its objectives total 75. The remaining 25 across original 3–7 is arithmetic only, not a verified per-group allocation. Section B heading is 50 marks and says answer any TEN of 20 offered groups, supporting 5 per group. No negative-marking instruction established.
